description.zh-CN: 采集公开汽车新闻与热搜，生成带来源状态的日报和本地看板。
description.en: Collect public automotive headlines and trends, then build a digest and local dashboard with source status.

description.zh-CN: 采集公开AI产品、硬件和人物言论，生成带增量与来源状态的日报和本地看板。
description.en: Collect public AI product, hardware and speaker headlines, with incremental briefs, source health and a local dashboard.

description.zh-CN: 用七类研究卡、官方GPU目录报价和产业动态梳理算力投资问题，保守去重并保留来源与未知。
description.en: Explore seven value-chain stages, official GPU catalog quotes and industry signals with conservative deduplication, sources and unknowns.

description.zh-CN: 跟踪AI原生工程发布与17份深入资料，结合本机Python静态关系证据设计验证。
description.en: Track AI-native engineering releases and 17 advanced primary resources, with local Python static graph evidence for validation.

description.zh-CN: 导入自己的词表，成片滑动浏览、点击或按片播放，并练习原创生活场景句子。
description.en: Import personal vocabulary, browse continuous slices, play words or slices, and practice original everyday phrases.

description.zh-CN: 跨产业整理实体用途、多种产地、上下游证据与时间变更，保留假设和待验证问题。
description.en: Organize cross-industry purposes, distinct location roles, evidence-backed relations and changes, with explicit hypotheses and open questions.
